title: Denzel Washington Draws Comparison To Tekashi 6ix9ine From Wack 100
htmlContent:
Last week, multiple news outlets, including XXL, reported that Wack 100 is working with 6ix9ine to secure the bag. In a recent Clubhouse chat session, which went viral on (Sept. 8), Wack, who is The Game and the manager of Blueface, claims to have $43 million in business on the table for Tekashi. While Wack has not identified himself as the manager of 6ix9ine, it seems that Wack is in that position with the business he does.

“It’s been about 30 or 45 days since I did the interview party on Clubhouse, right?” he said while on the voice-only communication app. “So, in the last 45 days, I probably done set up $43 million of business and I ain’t seen the kid. So, I’m talking about big movies, European tours, renegotiated his album terms all through attorneys and email."

On Wednesday evening, Wack 100 was in the Sleepless in LA room on the Clubhouse App and Denzel Washington to Tekashi 6ix9ine.

"Ay, that n**** Danny Hernandez is Denzel Washington he turns into that n**** [6ix9ine]. He is when call and you hear Danny, you would be like who is this," said Wack 100.

Speaking of Denzel Washington, he was recently replaced by Mahershala Ali in Julia Roberts' Netflix Movie 'Leave The World Behind,' according to Deadline. However, Deadline's Justin Kroll report does not share if Ali will be playing the role of Clay or G.H. Ali will also be featured in the upcoming Blade film, according to Screen Rant.
